== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Insidious Prisoner (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-insidiousprisoner-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-00-Insidious_Prisoner.png]]) show the original text; the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1273-13-front-master.png]]) shows PC-E2.

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type, 2012-07-21 capture: https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html; same text in every capture to 11 January 2013). Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “If A Stunning Move on table, deploy on Palpatine’s Quarters (if [Virtual Block 5 icon] We Have A Plan on table, this card always relocates to Palpatine if possible (even if a captive)); opponent may deploy a Jedi and/or a lightsaber here. Evil is Everywhere: Opponent may not Force drain here. Adds one [Dark Side icon] at same site. If just lost, relocate to Blockade Flagship: Prison. Once per turn, it a player controls this site, they may have this card (unless on Palpatine) follow their first character to move from here using landspeed or docking bay transit to a non-shielded site.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1273_13</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
